analytic_lineage.motivating_question: Can the positive dyadic inheritance mechanism be widened to root records using arbitrary divisor ancestry?

ancestor_inheritance_candidate.all_depth_consequence_if_proved: Divisor inclusion gives f(n+1)>=A(n), so Q_n<=f(n+1)+8 at every strict record.  For the last strict record n<=N, Q_N<=Q_n<=tau(n+1)+8<=2*sqrt(N+1)+8.  The Lean-checked subexponential-defect theorem then yields denominator-21 membership and infinite support.
ancestor_inheritance_candidate.falsifier: a strict record with required_additive_constant greater than eight
ancestor_inheritance_candidate.statement: For every strict record n, A(n)+8 >= Q_n+t_(n+1), where A(n)=max f(r+1) over earlier strict records r with r+1 dividing n+1, and A(n)=0 if the set is empty.

authority.method: exact divisibility mining over strict-record rows from the digest-validated historical exact replay receipt

canonical_parent_candidate.all_depth_consequence_if_proved: P8 directly gives Q_n<=f(n+1)+8 at every strict record by divisor inclusion, hence Q_N<=2*sqrt(N+1)+8 and the Lean-checked denominator-21 membership conclusion.
canonical_parent_candidate.falsifier: a strict record whose canonical largest-successor parent misses its repair bill by more than eight
canonical_parent_candidate.parent_definition: p(n)+1 is the numerically largest earlier strict-record successor dividing n+1; its inherited load is zero when no such successor exists
canonical_parent_candidate.statement: For every strict record n, f(p(n)+1)+8 >= Q_n+t_(n+1), with the absent-parent load defined as zero.

genealogical_polynomial_candidate.all_depth_consequence_if_proved: Each proper divisor-parent edge at least doubles the successor, so an n-record has genealogy depth at most log_2(n+1).  GP4 then gives Q_n=O((n+1)^2) at records, hence at every rank.  This polynomial bound feeds the Lean-checked subexponential-defect theorem and yields denominator-21 membership with infinite support.
falsifiers: a strict record above the finite seed with no earlier strict-record successor dividing its successor
a canonical parent edge with Q_child > 4*Q_parent
genealogical_polynomial_candidate.proof_advantage: GP4 discards all selected-divisor load estimates and is strictly weaker than P8/RR as a target producer.
genealogical_polynomial_candidate.statement: Every strict record n>19 has canonical divisor parent p(n), and Q_n <= 4*Q_p(n).

divisibility_chain_explanation.reason: the eligible successors include incomparable divisors, so load dominance is not automatic divisor inclusion

largest_parent_load_dominance_candidate.statement: Among earlier strict-record successors dividing a current record successor, the numerically largest has maximum selected-divisor load.

nonclaims: AI8 remains an all-depth conjecture, not a proof.
P8 and LPD remain all-depth conjectures, not proofs.
GP4 remains an all-depth conjecture, not a proof.
The finite sharpness of eight need not persist at later records.
This receipt does not by itself decide Erdos Problem 257.

parameters.ancestor_definition: earlier strict record r whose successor r+1 divides the current record successor n+1
